title: A prescribed finite etale generic extension has an etale residue-field model
statement: Let S be an irreducible scheme [def-pc-scheme] with generic point eta_S [def-sc-generic-point]. Let L be a field and let y_eta: Spec L to Spec kappa(eta_S) be a finite etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-residue-field]. There exist a scheme T, an etale map g:T to S, a generic point eta of T with g(eta)=eta_S, and an isomorphism r: Spec kappa(eta) to Spec L such that r followed by y_eta and the canonical residue-field point of S equals the canonical residue-field point of T followed by g.

proof.text: Choose an affine open containing the generic point of S. Its nilradical p is prime. The supplied finite etale field extension of kappa(p) is finite separable. Choose a primitive element; apply the existing residue_polynomial_lift lemma to multiply by a coefficient denominator outside p and lift its monic minimal polynomial to the affine ring R. Form the monic quotient B, finite free over R. Its generic fibre is the prescribed field L, including its structure map.

There is exactly one prime q of B over p. The fibre is separable and the quotient is flat, so the map is etale at q. The complement of the etale locus has closed image under the finite map, avoiding p. Restrict to a principal open of the base disjoint from that image. The resulting map is finite etale. For each prime Q of the localized quotient, flat going down gives a prime q_prime contained in Q and lying over p. The unique such prime is q, hence q is contained in every Q and is generic, also when R is nonreduced.

Compose the resulting etale map with the affine open immersion into S. The field isomorphism between kappa(q) and the supplied L gives the isomorphism r of spectra. The construction identifies their maps from the base residue field; functoriality of canonical residue-field point maps gives the required equality of maps to S. The generic point maps to eta_S.

proof_origin.note: Extracts steps 1 and 2 of the parent node, with the compatible residue-field point equality. The construction is independent of X; its proof remains the next stage-3 item.

mathlib_searches.query: A finite etale extension of the residue field at a generic point of an irreducible scheme extends to an etale scheme with that generic residue field
finite etale generic residue field extension spreads to etale scheme with prescribed generic residue field
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Algebra.exists_etale_bijective_residueFieldMap_and_map_eq_mul_and_isCoprime, Algebra.exists_etale_of_isEtaleAt and Algebra.Etale.exists_subalgebra_fg. None states the required scheme model.

Two hits in UniversalFactorizationRing and Etale/Locus; no prescribed generic scheme model. Local source search also checked SpreadFiniteSeparableExtension, GenericPointedEtaleExtension and EtaleGenericIrreducibleNeighbourhood. The first two require integrality and the last requires Noetherian hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_generic_residue_field_model {S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IrreducibleSpace S] {L : Type u} [Field L]
    (yη : Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶
      Spec (CommRingCat.of (S.residueField (genericPoint S))))
    [IsFinite yη] [Etale yη] :
    ∃ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S) (η : T)
      (r : Spec (CommRingCat.of (T.residueField η)) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)),
      Etale g ∧ IsGenericPoint η Set.univ ∧ g η = genericPoint S ∧
      r.hom ≫ yη ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint S) =
        T.fromSpecResidueField η ≫ g
